paper: Seeing What Matters: Generalizable AI-generated Video Detection with Forensic-Oriented Augmentation (WaveRep, Corvi, Cozzolino, Prashnani, De Mello, Nagano, Verdoliva, NeurIPS 2025, arXiv 2506.16802)
training_set_in_paper: The paper trains ONE detector on ONE generator (Pyramid Flow): that is the released weights_dinov2_G1.ckpt = key waverep. G4 (weights_dinov2_G4.ckpt = key waverep_g4) is trained on four generators (Pyramid Flow, CogVideoX 1.5, Allegro, Open-Sora Plan; Table 5) and is the demo's default. Both are the official checkpoints (no training code released for the model; only the augmentation), so there is no SynthScope-trained number. Metrics: balanced accuracy at 0.5 and AUC (Tables 1-2 and 7); video score = mean logit of the first 64 frames, center-cropped to 504 (App. D). The paper's own test set (7 generators vs 300 Panda-70M YouTube reals) is NOT held: the reals need a YouTube downloader and were not scraped. The only paper-comparable numbers here are the paper's 8 GenVideo columns, scored on GenVideo-Val with its own 10,000 reals (the paper does not say which reals it paired). Everything else is a zero-shot reference row, not a paper reproduction. Protocol is the same for every row: official OpenCV reader, first 64 frames, 504 centre crop, mean logit, threshold logit 0; exact parity with the official demo (15 videos / 6 codecs: inputs bit-exact, video logit max diff 6e-7; 180 GenVideo-Val files, both checkpoints: max |logit diff| 1.05e-5, 0 sign flips).

benchmarks.name: GenVideo-Val, the paper's 8 GenVideo generators (PARTIAL comparison)
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy at 0.5 and AUC, mean over the paper's 8 GenVideo columns (full GenVideo-Val: 10,000 reals + all fakes of each generator, 64 frames)

paper_number.note: Derived: mean of the 8 printed per-generator values (Table 1 bAcc, Table 7 AUC), 'Ours' = trained on Pyramid Flow only (= waverep, G1).

our_number.note: PARTIAL: the paper's 8 GenVideo columns, scored with GenVideo-Val's own 10,000 reals (the paper does not say which reals it paired). 5 of 8 within ~2 pts; HotShot (60.1 vs 81.4), Show-1 (79.7 vs 92.1) and LaVie (92.1 vs 95.5) NOT reproduced; HotShot fake recall 21%, AUC 75.6 (cause untested).

benchmarks.gap_cause: Cause untested. Real accuracy is 99.2 on every generator, so the HotShot gap is a low fake recall (21.0%), and AUC drops with it (75.6 vs 91.0), so it is not a threshold offset. A different real pool or fake subset in the paper (unstated) is a possible cause; we cannot test it. Show-1: fake recall 60.1%, AUC 94.3 vs 97.1; LaVie: 84.9%, AUC 97.0 vs 97.7. The other five cells are within 0.75 (ModelScope -1.86).
benchmarks.dataset_source: GenVideo-Val (ModelScope cccnju/Gen-Video), reals = MSR-VTT; tag waverep_genvideo_full.

benchmarks.name: The paper's own test set: Allegro, CogVideoX1.5, Open-Sora-Plan, Mochi-1, NOVA, Sora, FLUX vs 300 Panda-70M reals (NOT HELD)
benchmarks.gap_cause: NOT HELD: the 2,100 fakes are downloadable from grip.unina.it, but the 300 real clips are Panda-70M YouTube videos that need dataset/script_download_real.py with a YouTube downloader and cookies; not scraped. Without the reals there is no AUC or balanced accuracy, so a fakes-only run would not be the paper's benchmark.
